column1: # App-type partitions (ota_0/ota_1) MUST be offset-aligned to 0x10000 (64KB) — gen_esp32part.py
# enforces this at build time. data-type partitions are aligned here too
# Only one theme partition (theme_0): a bad/missing/corrupt theme falls back to the
# second slot for A/B rollback isn't needed. Revisit if OTA theme delivery ever needs it.
# Sized at 4MB even though a full theme (manifest + dial + ring + layout.json) is
# well under 1MB today — headroom for larger/animated assets later; bootmedia has
# ample spare space to give up (actual usage today is ~312KB of 7.875MB).
